# meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_group (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Network Firmware Upgrades Staged Group` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_group" "example" {
  network_id  = "L_123456"
  description = "The description of the group"
  is_default  = false
  name        = "My Staged Upgrade Group"
  assigned_devices_devices = [
    {
      name   = "Device Name"
      serial = "Q234-ABCD-5678"
    }
  ]
  assigned_devices_switch_stacks = [
    {
      id   = "1234"
      name = "Stack Name"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_default` (Boolean) Boolean indicating the default Group. Any device that does not have a group explicitly assigned will upgrade with this group
- `name` (String) Name of the Staged Upgrade Group. Length must be 1 to 255 characters
- `network_id` (String) Network ID

### Optional

- `assigned_devices_devices` (Attributes List) Data Array of Devices containing the name and serial (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assigned_devices_devices))
- `assigned_devices_switch_stacks` (Attributes List) Data Array of Switch Stacks containing the name and id (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assigned_devices_switch_stacks))
- `description` (String) Description of the Staged Upgrade Group. Length must be 1 to 255 characters

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--assigned_devices_devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assigned_devices_devices`

Required:

- `serial` (String) Serial of the device

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the device


<a id="nestedatt--assigned_devices_switch_stacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assigned_devices_switch_stacks`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the Switch Stack

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the Switch Stack

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_group.example
  identity = {
    network_id = "<network_id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_group.example
  id = "<network_id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_group.example "<network_id>"
```
